event: US October retail sales today, Tue 17 Nov, at 15:30 SAST (time UNVERIFIED; forecast +0.2% m/m), then FOMC minutes Wed 18 Nov at 21:00 SAST (time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Quiet morning range
bullets.text: Kitco showed spot gold at 3,868.90 bid at 11:02 SAST, up 13.40 (0.35%), in a 3,842.80-3,887.60 range today.

bullets.title: Prices disagree
bullets.text: Other feeds showed 3,864-3,878 this morning (Trading Economics, FXEmpire), so the exact price is UNVERIFIED within that band.

bullets.title: Near 13-month low
bullets.text: Gold is still close to Monday's 3,832 low, its lowest since about October 2025 (TradingKey, FXEmpire).

bullets.title: Hike nearly priced
bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about 95.5-96.6% odds of a December quarter-point hike (FXEmpire, TradingKey).

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: The dollar index is about 103.5 and the US 10-year yield about 5.12%, which keeps pressure on gold (Trading Economics, Mitrade).

bullets.title: Retail sales next
bullets.text: October retail sales are expected at +0.2% after +0.8%; a weak number could lift gold, a strong one could push it lower (TradingKey).

bullets.title: Hormuz still tense
bullets.text: Strait of Hormuz tensions are unresolved, but oil fell over 3% and the headlines are not lifting gold much (Mitrade).
